t: What a man was told to say when he asked to see again
a: أَسْأَلُكَ وَأَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ إِنِّي تَوَجَّهْتُ بِكَ إِلَى رَبِّي فِي حَاجَتِي هَذِهِ لِتُقْضَى لِي اللَّهُمَّ فَشَفِّعْهُ فِيَّ
p: Asʾaluka wa atawajjahu ilayka bi-nabiyyika Muḥammadin nabiyyi-r-raḥmah. Innī tawajjahtu bika ilā rabbī fī ḥājatī hādhihi li-tuqḍā lī. Allāhumma fa-shaffiʿhu fiyy
m: I ask You and I turn to You by Your prophet Muhammad, the prophet of mercy. I have turned by you to my Lord in this need of mine, so that it may be granted. O Allah, accept his intercession for me.
